statement_download.label: Statement download
statement_download.text: Steps: 1. Visit the official CAMS website. 2. Click on 'MF Investor.' 3. Select 'Statement' and then choose 'CAS - CAMS+KFintech.' 4. Statement Type: Detailed 5. Period: Specific Period (From 1st Jan 1990 to the present date) 6. Folio Listing: With zero balance folios 7. Email ID: Linked to your investments 8. Password: PAN number in uppercase 9. Submit the details. 10. You'll receive your CAS via email from in PDF format.
